_purpose: §67 개정된 공식 v3 정상 데이터 수집 계획 - docs/design/phase8-blue-green-preflight-incident.md §67과 동일 내용, 기계 판독용. official_collection_manifest.json(§65, sustained_load 포함 원래 계획)은 종료된 사전등록 이력으로 그대로 보존하고 수정하지 않는다 - 이 파일이 현재 유효한 계획다.
supersedes: official_collection_manifest.json (§65) - preserved as a concluded plan, not deleted or edited
scope: data collection and quality audit only - no model training, no threshold determination

sustained_load_permanently_excluded.reason: official-train-sustained_load-20260920 produced a genuine 30s-sustained SLO violation (t_slo not null) on an independent re-run, even though §64 qualification passed at the same intensity - reproducibility not established
sustained_load_permanently_excluded.action: removed from final candidate regimes; lowering intensity and re-trying under the same regime name is also out of scope for this Phase 8 data collection

burst.pattern: 0.025 RPS base (60s) x5 alternating with 0.10 RPS pulse (20s) x4

permanently_excluded_sessions.future_use: may be evaluated once as an external_anomaly_validation candidate only after model and threshold are fully frozen - not used for anomaly score or threshold review now

valid_session_conditions: t_slo == null (covers both 30s-sustained latency violation and immediate availability violation)
no missing/NaN/stale on any of the 8 feature source metrics (zero invalid windows)
feature window timestamps fall within session boundaries (window_boundary_ok)
burst_transient_policy: momentary per-stage P95 crossing the threshold is accepted as a normal transient as long as the true 30s-sustained slo_judge determination (t_slo) does not fire - unchanged from §64.1, judgment logic not modified

failure_and_rerun_rules.real_slo_violation_in_low_load_or_burst: stop remaining collection immediately, do not adjust intensity or run a substitute session, preserve the SLO-violating session as-is (do not erase it)
failure_and_rerun_rules.restart_oom_node_promotion_cleanup_failu: stop immediately, same as an SLO violation
failure_and_rerun_rules.technical_harness_error: preserve raw data, record with exact reason, fix code + pass offline tests, rerun from scratch under a NEW session_id

post_collection_audit_only_if_all_12_ses: overlapping window count reported separately from independent session count
whether the targeted session-level train/calibration/holdout composition is achievable
holdout_stage_gate: schema, completeness, and session-validity checks only - no anomaly score or FPR computation, no feature selection driven by holdout values
if_candidate_matrix_smaller_than_referen: report independent session count and row count separately - do not inflate apparent sufficiency via overlapping windows; propose (do not execute) a separate pre-registration for additional data in a later step
scope_limits: no holdout anomaly score or FPR computation

tooling.script: anomaly-detection/v3/qualify_normal_profile.py (unchanged session logic; added classify_official_session() pure function, 5 offline tests)
